name: Four Seasons Hotel Toronto
positioning: Four Seasons hotel in the heart of Yorkville, Toronto, with a 30,000-square-foot spa
best_for: Guests who want a Four Seasons stay in Yorkville
Guests who want a hotel spa with 19 treatment rooms

facts.text: Four Seasons Hotel Toronto is at 60 Yorkville Avenue, Toronto, Ontario.
The hotel is in the heart of Yorkville, near Bloor Street and Bay Street.
The hotel has 259 rooms in total.
Café Boulud is a French restaurant and brasserie by Chef Daniel Boulud.
d|bar by Chef Daniel Boulud is a cocktail bar, lounge and restaurant bar within the hotel.
The hotel's spa is 30,000 square feet.
The hotel's indoor relaxation pool is on the ninth floor.
The hotel describes itself as a Forbes 5-Star luxury hotel.

highlights.text: The guest rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows.
The Bellair Suite is on the 19th floor and has a fully equipped kitchen.
The Royal Suite is on the 21st floor.
The Canada Goose Lending Program lets guests borrow jackets during their stay.
Condé Nast Traveler says all furniture in the rooms was designed and manufactured in Canada.

considerations.text: The hotel is about 30 to 45 minutes by car from Toronto Pearson International Airport.
The fitness centre is available to registered hotel guests and residents only.
d|azur is a seasonal outdoor patio.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the upscale positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
